create.title: Fixed-modulus theta-bilinear source boundary for the D=1 outer-defect wave
create.statement_tex: Duke--Friedlander--Iwaniec Section 6 and Lemma 6.1 remain an exact pointwise match for every K(-v^2,-j;4N/d), including v=0, arbitrary composite modulus divisible by four, and all gcd strata. Their Theorem 2.5 and the current Sun--Proskurin half-integral Kuznetsov formulas have modulus-sum geometric sides, nonzero shifted-frequency hypotheses, and complete holomorphic, Maass, Eisenstein, residual, or exceptional spectral pieces. Lam Theorem 2.3 is a holomorphic varying-weight one-sequence large sieve. Blomer--Pascadi is fixed-modulus but ordinary-Kloosterman and separated-coefficient; Shparlinski--Xiao is prime-modulus and separated. None accepts the literal fixed modulus 4N/d, theta multiplier, mandatory zero/imprimitive rows, endpoints, or coupled matrix Bhat_j(2dv). The first source-unproved row is sum_(V<|j|<=2V) Bhat_j(0)K(0,-j;4N/d); the next is the nonzero coupled matrix. This is a primary-source direct-interface no-match checked through 2026-08-25, not an exhaustive bibliography or impossibility theorem, and it proves no positive-power range or exponent.
create.next_action: Use DFI Lemma 6.1 only termwise. First prove a signed fixed-modulus estimate or exact evaluation for the v=0 outer-j row with every d, sign, profile, and endpoint; then attack the nonzero coupled matrix without replacing it by separated coefficients or a modulus average.

create.title: Complete theta-frequency inverse-Gauss self-return and outer-defect norm obstruction
create.statement_tex: Fix A>0, J_A=M^(3/4)(log(2X))^A, K=sqrt(NM), and J_A<V<=K. In the literal D=d=L=1 ambient completion, let q=4N, let d|N be odd, c=q/d, H=c/2, Bhat_j(2dv)=sum_(x mod q)B_j(x)e_c(-2vx), and K(-v^2,-j;c)=sum_(a mod c)^* epsilon_a(c/a)e_c(-abar v^2-aj). Then sum_(v mod H)Bhat_j(2dv)K(-v^2,-j;c)=((1-i)/2)sqrt(c) sum_(x mod q)B_j(x)sum_(a mod c)^*chi_4(a)e_c(a(x^2-j)). Restoring -i(1+i)chi_4(d)d sqrt(c)/(2Nq), using dc=q, and summing the exact partition d=(h,N), h=da returns the original -i/(2N) odd-frequency quotient selector. Thus complete v-resummation is exactly the inverse of the quadratic Gauss completion and gives no second square-root saving. Sampled Parseval is sum_(v mod H)|Bhat_j(2dv)|^2=H sum_(r mod H)|sum_(x=r mod H)B_j(x)|^2; its folds have period 2N/d and yield only the upper norm capacity <<_epsilon(N^(3/2)/(dM)+N/M^(1/2))X^epsilon. The mandatory zero row has upper bound <<_epsilon(N^(-1/2)M^(-1/4)V+M^(-1/4))X^epsilon, while the nonzero termwise capacity remains M^(-3/4)VX^epsilon. A proper v cutoff translates to eta(u-ax) and remains nonseparable. The flat j phase localizes only to the circular arc ||a/c+1/(2sqrt(x^2-j))||<<1/V of capacity O(1+c/V), including both the wrapped near-zero and near-c branches. Hypothetical selected-incidence square-root cancellation would be target-sized only for V<=M^(3/2), but no such estimate or positive-power range is proved. The first open signed inputs are the fixed-modulus zero row and then the incomplete coupled nonzero matrix or equivalent selected cross-fibre theorem.
create.next_action: Do not repeat complete theta-frequency resummation, physical-diagonal-only Parseval, or bare flat-j localization as gains. First isolate the exact arithmetic transform of K(0,-j;4N/d) and prove a signed zero-row estimate; then seek a mask-preserving incomplete-v or selected cross-fibre theorem with a second gain above V=M^(3/2).

Retain DFI Lemma 6.1 as an individual-sum theorem only. The joint fixed-modulus outer-defect coefficient is source-unmatched; isolate v=0 before applying any nonzero-frequency trace formula.

Freeze complete v-resummation as the exact inverse-Gauss self-return. Attack the signed fixed-modulus v=0 row first, followed by the incomplete nonzero matrix or the selected cross-fibre partial-sum theorem, retaining both signs, endpoints, folds, and all d.

update.statement_tex: Round 151 leaves a low-two-adic h|g recovery fibre outside its recombined row corridors; D>1 and the generic complement remain open. At D=d=L=1, Rounds 152--154 give the literal square-root wave, target-safe exact and small defects, strict boundary M^449>>R^780, exact direct-wave return, root-defect cell, selected linearization, and every fixed-polylogarithmic collar. Round 155 proves that complete half-period resummation of the normalized theta-Kloosterman dual frequency exactly inverts the quadratic Gauss completion and restores the quotient selector. Sampled Parseval retains folds of period 2N/d; the zero-mode and nonzero termwise ledgers are only upper capacities; every proper dual cutoff remains coupled; and flat-j localization gives a wrapped circular reciprocal arc but no gain. The hypothetical square-root selected-incidence size is target-safe only for V<=M^(3/2) and is not proved. The first D=L=1 survivor is the signed fixed-modulus v=0 outer-j row, then the incomplete nonzero matrix or selected cross-fibre theorem, beyond the polylogarithmic collar. This is a route-scoped frontier, not a positive-power range, lower bound, or impossibility theorem.
update.next_action: At D=L=1, prove the signed zero-frequency theta row uniformly in d, signs, profile, and endpoints, then attack a genuinely incomplete nonzero transform or selected cross-fibre theorem with a second top-scale gain. Keep D>1 and every other owner separate.

The D=L=1 direct wave remains open beyond every fixed-polylogarithmic collar; complete theta resummation has been eliminated as a gain. Prove its zero row and incomplete signed remainder, plus D>1, L>1, generic t=1, every t>=2 layer, and the independent cross owner before global assembly.

reject.reason: The exact half-period transform cancels the theta multiplier and, after dc=q and the gcd partition, returns the original quotient selector with no residual square-root factor.
Every odd h modulo 4N is uniquely h=da with d=(h,N), including noncoprime d and N/d; all strata are required for selector restoration.
The quadratic summand has period c/2, so its sum is exactly half the complete even Gauss sum; this factor is essential to the restored -i/(2N) normalization.
It folds x modulo 2N/d and contains multiplicity O(1+dK/N), including large-d off-diagonal collisions.
The identity is an upper norm ledger and contains no orthogonality between outer defects or signed lower information.
The literal completion contains v=0, while the audited nonzero-frequency Kuznetsov formulas exclude it; its top upper capacity is M^(1/4)X^epsilon.
The displayed positive expression is obtained by pointwise DFI and absolute gcd summation and says nothing about the actual signed size.
It becomes eta(u-ax), retaining joint dependence on the unit a and physical variable x.
Only the constant complete cutoff is translation-invariant; every proper cutoff must price the translated chirp and its complement.
M^(-3/4)V^(1/2) is only a capacity calculation; no report proves the required signed square-root estimate.
At V=sqrt(NM) it is N^(1/4)M^(-1/2), target-sized only at the hard endpoint M asymp N^(1/2).
Its total variation is O(V/K)<=O(1); expansion only localizes to a circular reciprocal arc of capacity O(1+c/V).
The arc radius c/V exceeds its centre offset c/(2x), so positive representatives contain both the near-zero and near-c branches.
It is only a statement-only invertibility control; the accepted identity uses the literal epsilon_a(c/a) theta multiplier.
The literal coefficient is nonseparable; a decomposition must restore its total nuclear or variation norm before a separated theorem is legal.
The audited DFI and Sun geometric sides average moduli, and uniform delta localization at the growing fixed modulus is not supplied.
The source formulas explicitly retain holomorphic, Maass, Eisenstein, residual, or exceptional terms according to sign, and v=0 is outside their nonzero hypotheses.
It is a dated direct-interface audit and does not exclude another source or a new coefficient-sensitive incomplete transform.
Those owners have different fibres, coefficients, profiles, endpoints, and transforms and were outside the frozen scalar.
The zero row, incomplete nonzero matrix, other M1 and M2 owners, endpoint uniformity, M9, and the bridge all remain open.

round_assessment.reason: Round 155 proves the exact complete half-period inverse of the normalized theta Gauss completion, with every sign, gcd stratum, endpoint, and selector factor. It also establishes sampled Parseval with its large-d folds, isolates the zero-mode and partial-cutoff ledgers, and shows that flat-j localization and a hypothetical square-root incidence mechanism do not yield an all-scale theorem. This is genuine route-elimination and localization of the first missing signed row, but it proves no positive-power range, scale boundary, downstream obligation, or exponent.
